utah.precipitation: The primary feature in terms of enhanced precipitation is predicted to be surface low pressure developing across the Southwest and tracking across the Rockies at the beginning of the period.

ne.temperature: Troughing near Florida also pushes much of the Eastern Seaboard towards near-normal temperatures.
